objective: Make one exact EVF product candidate eligible for product approval and, only after a separate decision and rollback rehearsal, eligible for application to the Auth Service.

terminal_state_algebra.not_applicable_rule: Valid only when the selected profile names the stage, binds the authorizing rule, and supplies a stable reason code.
terminal_state_algebra.aggregate_rule: Every declared constituent is retained. No later pass, retry, or cleanup masks an earlier non-pass.

enforcement_stages.name: exact-semantic-source
enforcement_stages.required_evidence: Owner-authored meaning, stable source identity, exact refs, and claim ceiling.

enforcement_stages.name: projection-and-route-admission
enforcement_stages.required_evidence: Exact admitted projection or theorem/provider route classification with owner basis.

enforcement_stages.name: obligation-and-denominator
enforcement_stages.required_evidence: Stable route-specific obligation or theorem request IDs, complete denominator, provenance, and residue.

enforcement_stages.name: exact-implementation-binding
enforcement_stages.required_evidence: Unique binding from obligation/proof target to exact implementation, fixture, runtime, and lineage refs.

enforcement_stages.name: check-or-proof-target-selection
enforcement_stages.required_evidence: Generated or selected executable check, solver request, model property, or theorem target bound to S2 and S3.

enforcement_stages.name: runtime-and-provider-admission
enforcement_stages.required_evidence: Exact executable digest, version, command, directory, environment allowlist, resources, timeout, output, and network policy.

enforcement_stages.name: positive-execution
enforcement_stages.required_evidence: Provider-owned native result and execution facts for every positive case.

enforcement_stages.name: negative-controls
enforcement_stages.required_evidence: Every declared mutant executed and rejected by its cause-specific oracle.

enforcement_stages.name: native-result-normalization
enforcement_stages.required_evidence: Native outcome retained with explicit normalized mapping and typed residue.

enforcement_stages.name: evidence-composition
enforcement_stages.required_evidence: Exact request, facts, universe, property, mapping, scope, assumptions, and ceiling comparability.

enforcement_stages.name: receipt-construction
enforcement_stages.required_evidence: Atomic append-only stage and aggregate receipts with complete refs, states, residue, and claim ceiling.

enforcement_stages.name: independent-verification
enforcement_stages.required_evidence: Read-only recomputation of refs, edges, denominator, mappings, aggregate, and ceiling by a separate verifier.

enforcement_stages.name: replay-and-currentness
enforcement_stages.required_evidence: Per-ref currentness and clean-environment replay with identical canonical evidence-payload digest.

decision_gates.question: How will the scenario-specific v1 receipt evolve into generic stage and aggregate contracts?
What is the production kernel and compatibility boundary?
Which independently consumed route is the first complete source-to-consumer vertical?
decision_gates.owner: EVF product owner and independent consumer owner

nodes.title: Freeze the production-stability audit baseline
done_when: every cited source is exact-ref bound
current gaps and historical evidence are separated
Auth is marked downstream

nodes.title: Define production stability and the universal stage contract
done_when: every stage has entry, exit, failure, and evidence semantics
omission is invalid
not_applicable is profile-authorized only

nodes.title: Create agent-facing EVF ontology scaffolds
done_when: scaffolds map to definitions without asserting admission
selected dependency records and source bytes are explicit

nodes.title: Prototype product, business, DomainSpec, compiled-system, and implementation contracts
nodes.owner: EVF product, DomainSpec, and implementation owners
done_when: each plane owns only its declared meaning
all cross-plane joins use exact refs
technical receipts grant no authority

nodes.title: Resolve implementation-blocking owner decisions
done_when: all three decisions bind exact scope and rationale
defer and stop remain valid outcomes
no decision implies implementation authority

nodes.title: Compile generic profile, exact-ref, stage, and aggregate schemas
done_when: scenario constants are profile data rather than schema constants
all S0-S12 states are required
unknown fields and omitted constituents fail

nodes.title: Implement the content-addressed append-only run store
done_when: producer cannot overwrite a finalized run
interrupted runs are explicit
a new failed run cannot expose an earlier PASS as current

nodes.title: Implement the fail-closed stage-DAG executor
done_when: every profile materializes S0-S12
effectful execution stops at first real effectful failure
preacceptance can collect all not_evaluable dependents

nodes.title: Harden runtime and provider admission
done_when: no user-cache or ambient executable is silently selected
resource and output ceilings are enforced
unproved isolation blocks its dependent claim

nodes.title: Implement executable cause-specific negative controls
done_when: every mutant is actually executed
arbitrary nonzero exit does not count as killed
mutant denominator is exact and unchanged

nodes.title: Implement theorem-provider and meta-type theorem routing
done_when: theorem route does not require ordinary TDE artifacts
graph source and projection identities are exact
PASS_BOUNDED cannot imply runtime conformance

nodes.title: Implement native-result normalization and non-inflating composition
done_when: native outcomes remain reachable
each provider closes independently
join result is limited to supported intersection
validation: unknown timeout and malformed mapping tests

nodes.title: Implement the independent read-only verifier
done_when: verifier cannot write producer artifacts
every exact ref and DAG edge is recomputed
producer and verifier implementations fail differentially on tamper fixtures

nodes.title: Close the three reference profiles and one complete vertical
nodes.owner: EVF product owner and independent consumer owner
done_when: all profiles use the generic S0-S12 contract
one exact claim crosses the source-to-consumer vertical
consumer authors its own receipt
validation: independent verification of all three profiles

nodes.title: Pass the hostile conformance, recovery, and replay suite
done_when: every failure class reaches its expected terminal state
two clean runs share one canonical evidence-payload digest
no omission is reported as pass

nodes.title: Freeze one exact EVF product candidate
done_when: every product-test input is immutable and exact-ref bound
candidate scope and exclusions are explicit
post-freeze byte drift creates a new candidate

nodes.title: Execute current product tests for the frozen candidate
done_when: all required tests execute against the frozen digest
all stages and denominators close
results are current and replayable

nodes.title: Issue an independent production-stability assessment
done_when: assessment binds the exact candidate and test evidence
all exclusions remain visible
recommendation does not grant approval

nodes.title: Obtain the human EVF product decision
outputs: approve reject or defer decision bound to candidate digest
done_when: decision is human-owned, immutable, current, and exact-scope bound
approval does not grant adoption or enforcement

nodes.title: Make the separate bounded adoption and enforcement decision
done_when: product approval is current
decision names exact enforcement points and forbidden effects
no Auth activation is implied

nodes.title: Prove reference enforcement, degraded mode, and rollback
done_when: enforcement fails closed within authorized scope
rollback restores the exact predecessor
evidence remains immutable and reachable

nodes.title: Freeze a new Auth EVF semantic and candidate-input epoch
done_when: all campaign-consumed bytes are bound
trusted-boundary and scope-detector inputs are included
existing Auth prototype remains historical

nodes.title: Create the Auth EVF ontology scaffold and generic enforcement profile
nodes.owner: Auth DomainSpec and EVF profile owners
outputs: runtime provider and theorem route selections
done_when: all stages are present
token presence and unordered set membership are not accepted as proofs
route artifacts are exact
validation: derivation lineage and denominator negative fixtures

nodes.title: Implement Auth runtime, scope, provider, and semantic mutations
nodes.owner: Auth implementation and EVF validation owners
done_when: provider and scope mutations execute
one authorization-state epoch is observed
arbitrary cargo failure cannot kill a mutant

nodes.title: Generate and bind the Auth-specific meta-type theorem instance
done_when: foundation fixture is not reused as Auth proof
source graph and Rust projection digests are exact
theorem ceiling excludes runtime conformance

nodes.title: Freeze and product-test the Auth EVF candidate
nodes.owner: Auth product-test and independent verification owners
done_when: all Auth S0-S12 stages close
runtime and theorem branches join only through exact correspondence
two clean runs agree on evidence-payload digest

nodes.title: Obtain Auth product approval and a separate enforcement decision
nodes.owner: Auth product approval and enforcement owners
outputs: separate Auth enforcement or defer decision
cutover and rollback scope if authorized
done_when: product approval binds the exact Auth candidate
enforcement is a separate protected decision
no deployment or external effect exceeds the decision envelope

operational_tasks.blocking_basis: CyberAlchemy Goals validation is currently blocked; this blocks admitted registration, not creation of this planning candidate.
The present sandbox cannot complete the full tsx subprocess test because IPC socket creation returns EPERM.
Provider runtimes need portable exact manifests instead of ambient or user-cache paths.
A declared no-network policy is not host isolation evidence.
Retention, capacity, corruption recovery, and indexing are not yet production contracts.
Observability must exclude credentials and private semantic payloads while preserving useful stage facts.

production_stability_exit.rule: Auth work may not begin merely because a technical test passes; all preceding nodes must have current matching evidence and the human gates must return the required decisions.

claim_limit: Planning candidate only. It grants no implementation authority, EVF product approval, adoption, enforcement activation, Auth mutation, publication, release, deployment, or production claim.
